{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Bumps the project C++ standard requirement from C++20 to C++23 in CMakeLists.txt, depends, and CI scripts, raising minimum compiler versions to GCC 13 and Clang 19.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "unblocks #34979",
      "rationale": "Raising the baseline C++ standard across the build system is a major strategic transition that removes recurring workarounds and unblocks future C++23 features. As the author notes, 'workarounds to avoid C++23 keep accumulating' and moving compiler baselines unlocks dependent PRs like #34979."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only adds release notes accompanying the build requirement bump.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation is not the primary change; updating release notes merely follows from the build modification."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/index/ files solely through mechanical string search replacements.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not touch index logic, synchronization, or data structures."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp only to adopt std::views::zip in an internal import loop.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not affect the libbitcoinkernel API, boundary, or headers."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches src/i2p.cpp for mechanical string search modernization.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not touch network transport, peer selection, or protocol behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches RPC files only to replace string searches with .contains().",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not modify RPC interfaces, arguments, or serialization formats."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test files to remove obsolete polyfill tests (util_expected_tests.cpp) and apply mechanical string edits.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter test frameworks or harnesses; test deletions merely follow from removing utility polyfills."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches bitcoin-tx.cpp and bitcoin-tidy CMake configuration as secondary adjustments.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not substantively alter developer scripts or offline tooling functionality."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Deletes custom polyfills in src/util/expected.h and src/util/types.h in favor of std::expected and C++23 static_assert.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Retiring utility polyfills simplifies shared primitives across the project. Eliminating 117 lines from `src/util/expected.h` and adopting `std::byteswap` reduces maintenance overhead for error and compat utilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/node/blockstorage.cpp solely for mechanical string search modernization.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter validation rules, UTXO management, or block storage mechanisms."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches wallet files and unit tests only for mechanical .contains() replacements.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not affect wallet functionality, key management, coin selection, or database behavior."
    }
  ],

  }
